detail: Two claims of different types in two sentences: the intervention (system is inclusive) and a finding (not used to full potential). Recut to the first sentence (page 15) and add the second as a separate finding (0203).
An enforcement action, not clearly a law, strategy, system or programme (could be a finding); "started to issue" sits between implemented and in_progress.
judgement_call: yes: section 2 and R11 do not say whether enforcement actions by a named agency are interventions, and "started to" is not covered by the in_progress wording

judgement_call: yes: unclear whether the trailing clause is a separate in-scope claim or part of the broadband metric
